title: Provider name mismatch silently falls through to wrong provider
description: In src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c, crypto2dev_lookup_algo(): when provider is non-empty and no registered provider matches the name, the function currently falls through and returns the first provider that matches the algo name regardless of provider. Fix: if filter_provider is true and no entry matched both name and algo, return NULL. This causes ENOENT at the INIT/KEY_IMPORT call sites, which is the correct behaviour — the caller asked for wolfssl and there is no wolfssl, so fail explicitly rather than silently using kcapi.
